about: D10 §2.2's defaults shift table, one row per tone, as the first build ships it (blueprint 14.4: tuned later from test runs). Read by estimate.py (shot_length_factor times rhythm_class_asl_s), TIME-07 and the rhythm checks, and taught by card 08. Written by WP1 on 2026-09-28.
source: D10 §2.2 (research file and digest); every factor, range and budget there is [J], a starting value.
how_to_read: Read a row as 'from this scene's tone, start here'. A departure gets one line in the record's note (D10 §2.2).

shot_length_factor is D10's asl_factor: the multiplier on the scene's usual average shot length (D13 §5). Where D10 gives a range or a bound, shot_length_factor is the value the estimate uses and shot_length_note keeps D10's words.

contrast_band maps D10's light column onto B2 §2.3's bands (low about 2:1, medium about 4:1, high about 8:1, extreme 16:1 and beyond) and the LOOK contrast values; the mapping is WP1's [judgement]. In prompts write the visible result, never the ratio (B2).
music_default maps D10's sound column onto SOUNDPLAN.music_policy words [judgement]; the film's music policy is always the user's choice (K31) and every clip stays music-free.

display_level maps D10's performance column onto D15 §2.2's display levels 1-3 for a medium shot [judgement]; the closer the shot, the lower the level (D15), and display 3 at close-up or tighter needs a why (CRAFT-25).
Tone moves the dial, not the map: it never changes which beat is the turning point, what the text marks, or in-story footage and physics rules (D10 principle 1).

grave.size_and_lens: Approach progression; normal lens; tightest size on the turn
grave.sound_and_music: Sparse music that must not state subtext

tense.shot_length_note: 0.9, but hold on the unaware (A4 S2)
tense.size_and_lens: Sizes tighten across the scene; longer lens for watching
tense.camera_move: Static baseline; handheld only at loss of control (B1 R17)
tense.sound_and_music: Beds, a rising or ticking sound; score sparse

dread.shot_length_note: 1.3 before a startle; the startle shot under 1 s
dread.size_and_lens: Wides with empty areas; deep focus; threat partial or off frame
dread.camera_move: Static or very slow push toward empty space; the threat never causes a move
dread.sound_and_music: Sound before sight; rough textures; stings only on budgeted startles

enigmatic.size_and_lens: Objective framings; evidence inserts held to read (A4 R8)
enigmatic.camera_move: Static; move or rack only on a noticing beat

comic_light.size_and_lens: Wides and two-shots holding both bodies; normal-to-wide lens; deep focus
comic_light.camera_move: Static; any move timed to the reveal
comic_light.sound_and_music: Timed effects over music; no mickey-mousing

comic_dark.size_and_lens: Frontal, centred, symmetrical mediums and wides
comic_dark.sound_and_music: No music under jokes; one timed effect
comic_dark.opener: A dry, deadpan dark comedy scene.

romantic.size_and_lens: Two-shots and matched close singles; long lens along the line between them (B1 R13); shallow focus; anamorphic may fit (B1 §4.4)
romantic.camera_move: Slow, minimal; one push-in at the turn
romantic.light: Soft, warm key; low to medium contrast
romantic.sound_and_music: A theme is allowed if the music policy is scored

kinetic.size_and_lens: Calm geography wide first (A4 C6); wide lens near the action; each blow whole in frame
kinetic.camera_move: Follow or lead; one move per clip (B1)
kinetic.light: Hard, high contrast; flashes at most 3 per second (D10 §5)
kinetic.sound_and_music: Percussive; hits synced; music drops at the rupture

lyric.shot_length_note: Numbers: 2 to 4 (the estimate uses the middle, 3.0 [judgement])
lyric.size_and_lens: Full figure for dance; near-frontal for singing
lyric.camera_move: Track with the performer; one crane allowed
lyric.light: A light cue when the number starts
lyric.sound_and_music: Song locked first; cuts on bars (D10 §6)
lyric.opener: A joyful musical scene with singing.

wonder.size_and_lens: Clear, centred staging; eye level at the child's height
wonder.sound_and_music: Melodic score; music matched to action tolerated
wonder.opener: A bright, gentle family animation scene.

contemplative.shot_length_note: at least 2.5, never under 10 s average shot length
contemplative.size_and_lens: Wide or held medium; deep focus; the frame outlasts the action
contemplative.light: Natural, source-true, changing in real time
contemplative.sound_and_music: Ambient and field sound; no score, or source only
contemplative.opener: A slow, quiet, observational scene in one long take.
contemplative.open_question: D10's contemplative factor on top of D13's contemplative rhythm class gives about 15 s shots; D13 proposes renaming its class (D10 digest §8).
